title: Automated speed enforcement systems program; established.
bodyText: There shall be established the automated speed enforcement systems program, which shall be implemented by the State to enforce the speed restriction laws of the State. The automated speed enforcement system program shall be limited to only those locations where a photo red light imaging detector system has been implemented pursuant to chapter 291J.
bodyHtml: [§291L-2]  Automated speed enforcement systems program; established.  There shall be established the automated speed enforcement systems program, which shall be implemented by the State to enforce the speed restriction laws of the State.  The automated speed enforcement system program shall be limited to only those locations where a photo red light imaging detector system has been implemented pursuant to chapter 291J. [L 2024, c 112, pt of §2]
